build_EfficientNet_b0: build an EfficientNet b0 backbone model with default Swish activation and batch normalization
build_EfficientNet_EdgeTPU: build an EfficientNet EdgeTPU es backbone model using EdgeResidual blocks for edge deployment
build_EfficientNet_l2: build an EfficientNet l2 backbone model with the largest width and depth scaling factors
create_EdgeResidual_block: create an EdgeResidual block with configurable squeeze-and-excitation layer and residual connection
run_model_scaling: run the model_scaling function to scale layer width and depth for a given architecture setting
